admission.reason: This separate condition requires its own authenticated materials and actual Linux scientific image/cgroup/PID/runtime qualification. Existing strict-condition exports and receipts do not qualify it.

authoring_resources.requirement: Before an actual episode, predeclare a separate matched authoring/development resource policy and retain actual resource records and custody evidence. Do not fabricate these from the later execution cgroup.

claim_limits: Fixed-panel transductive comparison; no fresh-trial or inductive generalization claim
No faithful SMC reproduction claim for this improvement route
No original 5-ms NLB competition or leaderboard claim
No binary scientific improvement pass, meaningful superiority or equivalence claim
No biological generalization, causal-online claim or untouched holdout claim
No current SOTA, novelty or temporal-completeness claim
Code-plus-weights access effect does not isolate code alone
Released-model assistance does not establish independent training or native neural understanding
development_boundary: Provide only admitted TRAIN/VALID data and access-specific paper/source/assets before freezing the method, program, selected artifacts, seeds and adaptation procedure. Then release the authenticated complete permitted test held-in panel.
exposure_scope: The first test-input release within the admitted episode. This boundary does not prove that pretrained models or participants never encountered publicly available data in their history.

unchanged: original numerical evaluator and complete prediction ABI

outputs.comparison: Report the complete candidate vector and all retained SMC and LFADS/NDT signed differences; positive point differences alone are not scientific wins.

paper.title: Inferring stochastic low-rank recurrent neural networks from neural data

relation: Separately bound inference condition of the existing registered task; preserves strict local trial-independent and faithful source reproduction routes.

resource_profile.accounting_scope: One cumulative in-run execution budget per access condition, including training and adaptation performed in that execution. Do not reset it across iterations. The existing two-phase cgroup does not account for earlier authoring or development training outside its lifetime.
resource_profile.interpretation: An engineering access/resource setting, not proof of equal compute need or adequate independent-training resources.

scientific_question: Predict held-out neural activity and ten unseen future bins on the complete original MC_Maze 20-ms test panel. A frozen full-panel method may jointly use all supplied unlabeled test held-in observations, including declared adaptation.
title: SMC-RNN: full-panel offline improvement under declared test-input adaptation
